c: p:kono subarashii sekai ni syukufuku o
d:
Megumin goes off to train alone in the forest, determined to perfect her art of explosions! But she didn't count on an unexpected encounter with an orc, who is going to give her a hard time...

Surely training by the lake side is less risky, right ? That was certainly the opinion of Aqua, who had decided to do some stretching there... Imagine her surprise when a tentacle shot out from the depths of the water and began to pull her in !

Shortly after, Darkness decides to venture alone into a dark cavern. But you can imagine that, true to form, she's just looking for trouble...
